title: Obsidian's Tools
description: This mod adds a full Obsidian gear set — tools, weapons, and armor — that are tougher than Diamond but not as overpowered as Netherite.
body:
This mod adds a full Obsidian gear set — tools, weapons, and armor — that are tougher than Diamond but not as overpowered as Netherite.

Features

Obsidian Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, and Hoe
→ Stronger and more durable than Diamond gear.

Obsidian Armor Set
→ High durability, great protection, and natural resistance to fire and explosions.

Balanced progression
→ Perfect mid-to-late-game upgrade before Netherite.

Craftable with regular Obsidian (or your custom “Obsidian Ingot,” if you add one).

Balance Highlights

Armor protection equal to Diamond, but with extra toughness.

Tools mine everything Netherite can, with slightly slower speed.

Repairable with Obsidian.
